description.html: The Nomoy Pet NN-02 is a gray-brown artificial terrarium vine that resembles a natural liana. It is bendable, so you can shape it around the terrarium however you like: let it hang from the top, wrap it around a branch or stretch it from one wall to another. This gives your animal climbing paths and makes use of the upper part of the terrarium, which stays empty in many setups.

The vine is especially useful for species that like to climb, such as crested geckos, chameleons and other tree-dwelling lizards, as well as young snakes that explore at height. It combines well with artificial leaves, branches and backgrounds, giving the terrarium a rainforest look.

Before setting it up, wash the vine in lukewarm water and let it dry. Secure it at several points, to branches, decorations or suction cup hooks, and check that it holds your animal's weight before letting it climb. Do not make tight loops a small animal could get tangled in. It does not wilt or need watering, and when it gets dirty, just take it down and rinse it. Take a look at our terrariums too.
